Privacy Policy - Zest Travel

Zest Travel helps you search and book flights and hotels. This policy applies to our website and mobile app.

Information we collect
We collect your name, contact details, passport number, travel dates and payment information when you make a booking.

Why we collect it
We use this information to make bookings on your behalf, send confirmations and provide customer support.

Where your data is stored
Our application servers are located in Singapore and the United States. Our email provider is hosted in the European Union. By using the service you understand that your information will be processed in these countries.

Sharing with travel partners
We pass booking details to airlines, hotels and payment processors so that they can complete your reservation.

Your choices
You can opt out of promotional emails at any time using the unsubscribe link.
